# Phase 10 Human Review Checklist

Use this checklist during manual review of the generated headphone-amp schematic.

## Quick Pass

- [ ] I can identify input, gain stage, output, and power blocks quickly.
- [ ] I can follow the main signal path quickly from input to output.
- [ ] Grounds and power presentation are visually controlled (not cluttered).
- [ ] The op-amp area makes sense at a glance.
